briefings.title: Sam Altman on Elon Musk, ‘Artificial,’ and the Future of Humanity (Part One)
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledges the immense civilizational stakes and public anxiety surrounding artificial intelligence, defending the company's dual focus on rapid technological progress and societal safety while navigating unprecedented industry growth and leadership changes.

briefings.title: Sam Altman: The benefits of AI are worth ‘some bad things’
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman defended the company's willingness to accept bounded risks in exchange for AI's massive benefits during an interview with POLITICO's Brendan Bordelon, while addressing safety incidents, industry regulation, and geopolitical competition.

briefings.title: How Sam Altman Actually Uses AI to Run OpenAI and His Life
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman discusses how OpenAI's new "Dot" persistent agent protects his morning creative time, why developer demand for AI remains deeply human-centered, and how OpenAI is betting on a decentralized "Renaissance" for builders rather than a single corporate monopoly.

briefings.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman Talks IPO Planning, DevDay | Bloomberg Talks
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman discussed the company's rapid growth and product roadmap at DevDay, highlighting the launch of the new agent DOTS and the model GPT-6.1 Soul.

briefings.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 Keynote (FULL)
briefings.tldr: OpenAI announced over 20 new products and features at DevDay 2026—led by personal autonomous agents called "dots," collaborative workspace "ChatGPT spaces," new frontier models like GPT-6.1 Sol and UltraFast, and cloud-native developer tooling—aiming to transform AI from a conversational assistant into an active, 24/7 collaborative partner.

briefings.title: AI CEOs Brief the U.N. Security Council
briefings.tldr: AI CEOs and UN Security Council members debated the acute risks of frontier AI systems—including autonomous cyberattacks, loss of human control, and bioweapons proliferation—while dividing sharply over whether to establish binding international regulatory frameworks or rely on sovereign tech adoption and permissionless innovation.

briefings.title: Why Dario Amodei and Sam Altman Are Faking the AI Doomsday Crisis | The Weekly Wrap
briefings.tldr: Steve Eisman breaks down why Dario Amodei and Sam Altman’s AI extinction warnings are a strategic shell game to invite regulation and build pricing moats, while also covering rate hikes, his FICO short, and portfolio diversification away from AI.

briefings.title: Marc Benioff & Sam Altman | Dreamforce 2026
briefings.tldr: Marc Benioff and Sam Altman discuss the rapid advancement of generative AI at Dreamforce 2026, highlighting the emergence of powerful autonomous models, enterprise agentic workflows, and the critical need for industry-wide safety, alignment, and robust cyber defense.

briefings.title: Altman: AI Beyond Human Control “Absolutely” Possible, Vows Safeguards | Titans and Disruptors
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledges the existential risks of advanced AI and superintelligence, maintaining that OpenAI will pause training runs if safety and alignment cannot be assured.

briefings.title: AI Industry Has Done 'Terrible Job' of Communicating Benefits, Says Sam Altman
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman admitted the AI industry has done a "terrible job" communicating technology benefits to the public while discussing the release of GPT-6 (Astra), which hit cyber-critical thresholds by autonomously finding zero-day exploits.

briefings.title: OpenAI's Sam Altman on Astra Model Debut, Benefits of AI
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman debuted GPT-6 Astra on Bloomberg Television, framing it as an early step toward AGI and noting it can autonomously find zero-day exploits.

briefings.title: Special Edition: OpeanAI CEO Sam Altman Talks GPT-6 Astra Debut, Going Public | Bloomberg Tech
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman discussed the debut of GPT-6 Astra on Bloomberg Tech, emphasizing its autonomous capabilities, multi-tiered safety guardrails for cyber threats, and OpenAI's long-term intention to eventually go public while prioritizing its core mission.

briefings.title: Commerce Sec. Lutnick and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman participate in a fireside chat — 9/2/2026
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick discussed the trajectory of artificial intelligence at the G20 Innovation Ministerial, framing AI as a transformative economic engine comparable to electricity or the industrial revolution.

briefings.title: LIVE: OpenAI's Sam Altman speaks at G20 Innovation Ministerial
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman argues that AI represents a historic, continuous technological revolution akin to electricity, predicting that making intelligence abundant and inexpensive will fuel an unprecedented boom in global entrepreneurship and education while requiring massive infrastructure investment and proactive risk management.

briefings.title: Sam Altman And Howard Lutnick Discuss AI, Economy At G20 Innovation Ministerial
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman discusses the evolution of OpenAI and artificial intelligence with Howard Lutnick at the G20 Innovation Ministerial, framing AI as an inevitable, electricity-like global commodity that will drive unprecedented economic growth, entrepreneurship, and democratization of education.

briefings.title: Sam Altman on Astra, AGI, and the future of OpenAI
briefings.tldr: OpenAI has delayed a frontier reinforcement learning training run and reallocated compute to safety, alignment, and monitoring systems following internal misalignment signals and the "Hugging Face" security incident, while commercial growth surges with enterprise revenue now surpassing consumer revenue.

briefings.title: Sam Altman on Trump, Elon Musk and the race to AGI

people.name: Danny Fortson
people.role: West Coast Correspondent, The Sunday Times

briefings.tldr: Two years after launching ChatGPT, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman predicts that 10-year AI advancements will give every person more leverage than today's most impactful individuals, while acknowledging that the economic transition for knowledge workers will likely be painful.

briefings.title: Sam Altman: "Never a Better Time to Do a Startup"
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman and Garry Tan closed Startup School 2026 by discussing how AI coding agents and plummeting compute costs make this the greatest era in history to launch ambitious startups.

briefings.title: Sam Altman on AGI, Compute, and Human Agency
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman discusses OpenAI’s strategic refocus on foundational intelligence, the unprecedented race for compute, and navigating the societal and technological transition toward AGI while preserving human agency.

briefings.title: Sam Altman - How to Start a Startup
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman discusses how the explosive progress of AI is reshaping startups, the extreme chaos of scaling OpenAI, and his vision for abundant intelligence, decentralized liberty, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

briefings.title: Stanford CS153 Frontier Systems | Scale, AGI, and the Future of Everything
briefings.tldr: AI scaling laws reliably produce emergent properties beyond consensus expectations, shifting the startup paradigm from building large engineering teams to leveraging cheap, abundant tokens.

briefings.title: BREAKING: Elon Musk's First Interview Since Jury Rejected Claim Against Altman's OpenAI
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk predicts that AI will surpass human intelligence in every metric within two years and advocates for moving massive AI data centers into space to harness solar energy, while warning that OpenAI’s transition to a for-profit model sets a "dangerous precedent" for looting charitable organizations.

briefings.title: Sam Altman in conversation with Patrick Collison
briefings.tldr: OpenAI Cofounder and CEO Sam Altman and Stripe CEO Patrick Collison discuss the parabolic rise of AI agents, OpenAI's transition into a high-volume global utility provider, and how the democratization of frontier models is fundamentally shifting the landscape for startups, enterprise operations, and scientific discovery.

briefings.title: Stripe Sessions 2026 | Indexing the economy
briefings.tldr: Stripe’s macroeconomic data reveals that despite market volatility and fears of job displacement, the global economy is structurally replatforming around AI through a massive surge in hyper-lean, high-revenue solopreneurship and the rapid emergence of autonomous, machine-to-machine commerce.

briefings.title: Stripe Sessions 2026 | Keynote
briefings.tldr: At Stripe Sessions 2026, Stripe declared the arrival of the "agentic era" and unveiled its economic infrastructure for AI, featuring autonomous agent-to-agent payments via the Tempo blockchain, token-theft fraud defense, and the Platform Growth Studio to help businesses thrive in an economy re-platforming around AI.

briefings.title: OpenAI's Sam Altman trusts AI will treat most diseases by 2035
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman predicts that AI will be able to treat or mitigate most diseases by 2035, viewing cellular reprogramming and AI-driven discovery as the "Gordian knot" that will solve the root causes of aging and healthcare inequality.

briefings.title: Musk vs Altlman & Taylor Swift Trademarks | Bloomberg Law
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk is seeking to unwind OpenAI's for-profit conversion in a high-stakes trial alleging the "theft" of a non-profit charity, while Taylor Swift is pioneering a novel legal strategy using trademark law to combat AI deepfakes.

briefings.title: Claude Crushes SaaS, NVDA & GOOGL Near $5 Trillion, Elon Musk vs Sam Altman, Bitcoin Back to $80K
briefings.tldr: Mike Novogratz predicts an "AI productivity miracle" will drive the S&P 500 and Bitcoin significantly higher by year-end, even as generative AI tools like Claude threaten to dismantle the traditional SaaS and VC business models by allowing small teams to replicate billion-dollar companies.

briefings.title: Sam Altman in conversation with Patrick Collison
briefings.tldr: OpenAI is entering its third phase as a "mega-scale token factory for the world," aiming to become a low-margin, high-volume infrastructure utility that accelerates global economic output and scientific discovery.

briefings.title: Introducing ChatGPT Images 2.0
briefings.tldr: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Images 2.0 (Imagen 2.0), a major architectural leap that shifts from simple image generation to "visual reasoning," enabling perfect multilingual text rendering, multi-page document creation, and a "Thinking Mode" for complex, research-based visuals.

briefings.title: Sam Altman’s Attack, Amazon vs. Starlink, and What Opus 4.7 Actually Means | #248
briefings.tldr: Anthropic's Opus 4.7 dropped to mixed reviews amid rising AI anxiety and physical backlash, while the Stanford 2026 AI Index highlighted soaring benchmarks alongside youth hiring freezes and falling model transparency.

briefings.title: The AI Hate is Existential | Everybody's Business
briefings.tldr: Public sentiment toward AI has shifted from optimism to existential dread, leading to physical violence against tech leaders and a "broken" job market where recent college graduates face significant underemployment and a mismatch between education and industry needs.

briefings.title: Why the A.I. Backlash Turned Violent in America
briefings.tldr: Public sentiment toward AI is shifting toward radicalization and violence, driven by deep economic anxiety, a perceived lack of democratic oversight, and rising local opposition to massive data center infrastructure.

briefings.title: Ronan Farrow on Sam Altman's strained relationship with the truth | Decoder
briefings.tldr: Investigative reporter Ronan Farrow characterizes Sam Altman as a leader "unconstrained by the truth," driven by a paradoxical combination of extreme people-pleasing and a sociopathic disregard for the consequences of deception, which has led to a "race to the bottom" regarding AI safety.

briefings.title: Elon Musk vs. Sam Altman, AI Job Loss, and OpenAI’s $852B Valuation | EP #247
briefings.tldr: The AI industry is entering a "geopolitical and governance war" phase, characterized by the Musk vs. Altman $100B lawsuit, massive capital redirection toward Anthropic, and the rapid migration of AI intelligence into physical robotics and biological drug discovery.

briefings.title: Dentro de la Megafábrica Stargate de OpenAI con Sam Altman | The Circuit
briefings.tldr: Project Stargate is a historic $100 billion to $500 billion AI infrastructure initiative in Abilene, Texas, led by OpenAI, SoftBank, and Oracle to build the world’s largest computing clusters and accelerate the path to Artificial General Intelligence (AGI).

briefings.title: Sam Altman’s Trust Issues at OpenAI | The New Yorker Radio Hour
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman is characterized as a "Michael Jordan of listening" whose skill in reflecting what others want to hear has driven OpenAI’s success but created a deep "trust crisis" regarding his transparency and long-term commitment to safety.

briefings.title: The Dark Side of Sam Altman's Ambition
briefings.tldr: Investigative reporters Ronan Farrow and Andrew Marantz detail a "forensic and even" portrait of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, revealing a long-standing pattern of alleged manipulation, strategic deception, and a lack of institutional transparency that persists despite his public commitment to AI safety.

briefings.title: Investigating Altman With Ronan Farrow and Andrew Marantz | Better Offline
briefings.tldr: An investigation into OpenAI CEO Sam Altman reveals a documented pattern of perceived manipulation and "circular" financial dealings that prioritize investor interests over the company’s original safety-focused non-profit mission.

briefings.title: Why The OpenAI Legal Battle Could Redefine The Future Of Artificial Intelligence
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk’s $134 billion lawsuit against OpenAI, set for trial in late April, represents a fundamental clash over whether the future of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) should remain a nonprofit public good or a high-capital for-profit enterprise.

briefings.title: Sam Altman on Building the Future of AI
briefings.tldr: OpenAI leadership warns that the transition to superintelligence is imminent, necessitating an immediate "New Industrial Policy" to build massive compute infrastructure, reform tax systems, and create AI-driven "defensive shields" against cyber and biological threats.

briefings.title: OpenAI’s warning: Washington isn’t ready for what’s coming
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns that the next generation of AI models will represent a "significant step forward," potentially enabling career-defining scientific discoveries while simultaneously creating urgent, "world-shaking" cybersecurity and biosecurity risks that Washington is currently unprepared to manage.

briefings.title: FULL FIRESIDE: Open AI CEO Sam Altman & VC Vinod Khosla at IIT Delhi
briefings.tldr: AI is driving a fundamental global shift from a world of scarcity to one of abundance, with the cost of intelligence trending toward zero.

briefings.title: Sam Altman at India AI Summit: 'Superintelligence is only a couple of years away' | Tech Today
briefings.tldr: India is positioning itself as the global "nerve center" for AI through a $100B+ mission focused on inclusivity and ethical governance, while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman predicts the emergence of early superintelligence by 2028.

briefings.title: Fireside Chat: Sam Altman×Vinod Khosla and AMA at IIT Delhi | 20 February 2026
briefings.tldr: The advent of superintelligence marks a transition from a world of scarcity to one of extreme abundance and deflation, where human "agency" and "resilience" will become more valuable than technical expertise.

briefings.title: "AI Will Reshape Geopolitics" – Sam Altman’s Warning to World Leaders
briefings.tldr: The build-out of AI compute capacity represents the most expensive and complex infrastructure project in human history, requiring a shift from "libertarian" tech ideals toward deep government partnerships to ensure superintelligence remains decentralized and democratically governed.

briefings.title: Sam Altman Unfiltered: ChatGPT, AI Risks & What’s Coming Next, 40 Questions in 60 Minutes
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman reports that AI has evolved from high-school competency to research-level mathematics in just one year, signaling that AGI and Superintelligence (ASI) are approaching faster than previously anticipated.

briefings.title: LIVE: OpenAI's Sam Altman address at India AI Impact Summit in Delhi
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman projects that by 2028, data centers may hold more intellectual capacity than the human population, requiring a global shift toward decentralized "democratic AI" and international governance frameworks similar to the IAEA to manage the transition to superintelligence.

briefings.title: Frontier Models & AI | Sam Altman, CEO & Co-Founder, OpenAI and Jeetu Patel.

briefings.tldr: AI models like Codex and OpenClaw are ushering in a "ChatGPT moment" for knowledge work and software development, but their widespread adoption is challenged by the need for new security paradigms, redesigned software, and faster enterprise absorption, demanding significant infrastructure investment and a shift to thinking about AI as a collaborator, not just a tool.

briefings.title: FULL INTERVIEW: Sam Altman Responds to Anthropic’s Attack Ads, Live on TBPN
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman discussed the launch of GPT-5.3-Codex, highlighting its role in enabling a future where users manage AI agents at higher levels of abstraction for complex tasks.

briefings.title: Frontier Models & AI | Sam Altman, CEO & Co-Founder, OpenAI
briefings.tldr: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, emphasizes AI's rapid creation of economic value, particularly with Codex, predicting a subjective "10x improvement" in model capability this year.

briefings.title: OpenAI Town Hall with Sam Altman
briefings.tldr: AI is rapidly changing the nature of work, making creation massively cheaper and faster, demanding a shift in skills from specific coding to high agency and idea generation.
